title: OBJECTS Frame
tagline: Spatial design onchain. Mint, Remix, Make the physical world in a frame.
description:
View onchain 3D NFTs in a frame. Actions you can take: upvote (more like this and give me the option to collect), downvote (less like this), send me a 3D printed version, subscribe to the feed in your wallet

A way to learn if bringing the design of physical things onchain is something people are interested in. An easy way to think about the frame is Botto as a spatial/physical designer instead of a 2D artist.
how_its_made:
XMTP for subscriptions
Airstack APIs to grab NFTs and Farcaster data
Dynamic used for account abstraction for accounts not already onboarded to web3
Spatial designs made on Base chain
Pinata to host 3D models
Bambu lab printer for protoypes. More robust manufacturing for more advanced designs
